claim.purpose: Implement and validate Kimi and MiniMax hosted provider adapter routes

initial.title: [v0.91.8][provider] Route Kimi and MiniMax through adl-provider-adapter
initial.goal: Add reliable Rust-native hosted adapter routes for Kimi/Moonshot and MiniMax.
initial.required_outcome: Typed Kimi and MiniMax dispatch, bounded request contracts, provider error classification, focused tests, and live credentialed probe evidence.
authority_boundary: The adapter owns request routing, bounded payloads, response extraction, and typed provider failures; it does not provision credentials or alter lifecycle policy.
initial.task_boundary: Implement and validate the two hosted provider adapter routes and their bounded tests.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Kimi and MiniMax dispatch through adl-provider-adapter with bearer credentials.
AC-2: Requests use bounded provider-compatible model, message, and token fields.
AC-3: MiniMax billing/error envelopes and Kimi insufficient-balance responses are typed and non-retryable where appropriate.
AC-4: Focused tests prove auth, request shape, response extraction, redaction, and billing classification.
AC-5: Live probes reach both providers through the adapter and retain truthful credit-failure evidence when accounts cannot execute.
dependencies: approved Moonshot and MiniMax credential files
initial.plan_summary: Add two typed hosted routes, prove their request/error contracts with focused Rust tests, run live adapter probes, obtain exact-head review, and publish.

steps.action: Implement Kimi and MiniMax dispatch, endpoints, bounded payloads, and error classification.
Run focused tests, live probes, and exact-head review; repair findings.
Publish the reviewed exact head and verify PR state.

invariants: provider credentials never enter records or logs
billing failures do not retry indefinitely
risks: provider account balance blocks live success
stop_conditions: provider endpoint contract cannot be verified
focused validation fails outside the bounded provider surface

validation_lanes.proof_role: focused adapter tests for routing, budgets, envelopes, and redaction
credentialed Kimi and MiniMax adapter calls with truthful credit disposition
validation_lanes.defer_reason: provider account balance may block successful completion

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on unsupported routes, malformed envelopes, missing credentials, unbounded budgets, or redaction failures; preserve live credit blockers as evidence.
review_prompts: Check Kimi and MiniMax endpoint and auth contracts
Check bounded token and retry behavior
Check MiniMax success-status error envelopes and credential redaction
